Subject: Re: Fwd: DSR: Please delete account but preserve invoices

Hi Lauren —

Summary (short answer for customer):
- Redwood can honor the DSR to remove personal data while preserving accounting artifacts (invoices and usage ledgers) required for financial audit and tax compliance. We treat invoices and aggregated usage records as billing records that are retained under our accounting retention obligations.

Operational steps (internal):
1) Finance will export the canonical invoice PDFs and the raw usage export for the requested date range and attach to a finance-only preservation container. (Files: invoice_2023-12_acme.pdf, acme_usage_export_2023-12.csv)
2) Legal will apply a documented legal/finance "preservation flag" to the account to prevent automated erasure of those artifacts. This flag requires sign-off from Head of Finance (Rachel) and Legal.
3) Product/Infra will proceed with targeted erasure of personal identifiers (email addresses, user profiles, chat history snippets that contain personal PII) after the preservation artifacts are exported and stored. Erasure runbook will be recorded in the DSR ticket.
4) Retention window for preserved billing artifacts: minimum 7 years for tax/evidence; we will confirm exact period for Acme and document exceptions.

Customer action items:
- Confirm the exact invoice date range they need preserved (they mentioned Dec 2023–Dec 2026).
- Sign a short Finance Retention Acknowledgement (template: finance-retention-ack.pdf) so we have permission to maintain preserved artifacts beyond the standard erasure.

Questions for Rachel: are we good to proceed with a 7-year default retention for Acme invoices, and can you sign off on applying the preservation flag? Also confirm who in Legal will co-sign.

--
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Privacy Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments included: invoice_2023-12_acme.pdf (stub), acme_usage_export_2023-12.csv (stub)

Liam —

Thanks for the note. We can accommodate Acme's request. Proposed plan below — please confirm asap so we can schedule the export before your month-end audit:

What we will do for Acme:
- Export and preserve canonical invoice PDFs and the raw usage ledger for the date range you specify. These artifacts will be retained in a finance-only preservation container and will not be exposed or used for profiling.
- Proceed with erasure of personal data (user profiles, email addresses, end-user personal content) once exports are complete and the preservation flag is applied.
- Retention period for preserved billing artifacts: standard 7 years, unless you request a shorter window.

What we need from Acme:
- Confirm the exact invoice date range to preserve (you previously mentioned Dec 2023–Dec 2026).
- Sign the attached Finance Retention Acknowledgement. Once signed we will apply the preservation flag and run the export.

Timeline: once we have the signed acknowledgement and confirmed date range, we'll complete the export within 48 hours and notify you when erasure starts.

If you want, we can also provide a stamped copy of the exported invoice package (hash + manifest) and a DocuSign envelope for the retention acknowledgement (link included).

Best regards,
